Most of its members are ascendant mortals, and in each company of a thousand there are only ten places for those who are neither mortal nor seraphic. All are received as equals, yet that exalted equality never abolishes individuality or personal identity. The principle that unity is not uniformity holds even on Paradise.

text: The corps is organized in accordance with the working associations of the worlds of space and in keeping with the associative experience acquired throughout the long and eventful ascendant career. All the ascendant creatures admitted to this corps are received in equality, but this exalted equality in no way abrogates individuality or destroys personal identity.

Ascendant Adjuster-fused mortals compose the bulk of the primary Corps of the Finality. … The Havona natives, glorified Material Sons, glorified midway creatures, the Gravity Messengers, and the unknown and missing member make up only one per cent of the corps; each company of one thousand finaliters has places for just ten of these nonmortal and nonseraphic personalities.

ch37.s2: The Present Mission of Perfected Mortals
ch37.s2.u1.k: Mortal finaliters have found God, yet they have not reached final destiny.
ch37.s2.u1.p: The finaliters are those who have fully complied with the injunction of the ages, "Be you perfect." They have found God and reached the present limit of creature perfection. But the text carefully adds that this is not the finality of ultimate spirit status or of service. The finaliters stand only at the limit now attainable; the farther road of spirit attainment, of service, and of Deity experience still lies open before them.

text: The mortal finaliters have fully complied with the injunction of the ages, "Be you perfect"; they have ascended the universal path of mortal attainment; they have found God, and they have been duly inducted into the Corps of the Finality. Such beings have attained the present limit of spirit progression but not finality of ultimate spirit status.

ch37.s2.u2.k: Finaliters return to serve in the universes of time, and some are always present on Urantia.
ch37.s2.u2.p: Ascenders who reach Paradise do not settle there to rest. The finaliters return to the universes of time, serving in one superuniverse after another and receiving assignment to their native superuniverse only after serving in all six others. In this way they acquire a sevenfold understanding of the Supreme Being. The text says that companies of mortal finaliters are always serving on Urantia. Those who went before are even now at work beside those who follow.

text: During the present universe age the finaliters return to serve in the universes of time. They are assigned to labor successively in the different superuniverses and never in their native superuniverses until after they have served in all the other six supercreations. Thus may they acquire the sevenfold concept of the Supreme Being.

One or more companies of the mortal finaliters are constantly in service on Urantia. There is no domain of universe service to which they are not assigned; they function universally and with alternating and equal periods of assigned duty and free service.

ch37.s2.u3.k: Why are the Gods so concerned to train surviving mortals so thoroughly in universe management?
ch37.s2.u3.p: The present assignments of the finaliters look like postgraduate courses in universe understanding and superuniverse administration. A natural question follows: what is all this training for? It adds that even without any future destiny the present assignment would fully justify the plan of ascent, yet it foresees that future ages in outer space will reveal the wisdom and loving-kindness of the Gods still more fully.

text: It seems evident to us that the present assignments of the perfected evolutionary creatures partake of the nature of postgraduate courses in universe understanding and superuniverse administration; and we all ask, "Why should the Gods be so concerned in so thoroughly training surviving mortals in the technique of universe management?"

If there should be no future or unrevealed destiny for the Mortal Corps of the Finality, the present assignment of these ascendant beings would be altogether adequate and glorious. Their present destiny wholly justifies the universal plan of evolutionary ascent. But the future ages of the evolution of the spheres of outer space will undoubtedly further elaborate, and with more repleteness divinely illuminate, the wisdom and loving-kindness of the Gods in the execution of their divine plan of human survival and mortal ascension.

ch37.s3: The Seven Corps of Finality and the Outer Universes
ch37.s3.u1.k: The mobilization of the seven finaliter corps is the grand universe's divinity response to outer space.
ch37.s3.u1.p: The Corps of Mortal Finaliters is not alone. Seven corps of finality are assembling on Paradise, among them the Corps of the Unrevealed Sons of Destiny. The text sees this mobilization as the activity of the Ultimate Trinity preparing for inconceivable developments in outer space. The universe is now preparing for the next age.

text: The senior Master Architect has the oversight of the seven Corps of the Finality, and they are:
1. The Corps of Mortal Finaliters.
2. The Corps of Paradise Finaliters.
3. The Corps of Trinitized Finaliters.
4. The Corps of Conjoint Trinitized Finaliters.
5. The Corps of Havona Finaliters.
6. The Corps of Transcendental Finaliters.
7. The Corps of Unrevealed Sons of Destiny.

These seven finaliter corps probably signify the present activity of the Ultimate Trinity engaged in mustering the forces of the finite and the absonite in preparation for inconceivable developments in the universes of outer space. … The seven finaliter corps represent the divinity response of the grand universe to the future needs of the undeveloped potentials in the outer universes of future-eternal activities.

ch37.s3.u2.k: The assembling finaliters are destined for future service in the universes of outer space.
ch37.s3.u2.p: The revelators frankly admit that they do not know the plans for the outer creations. Yet of some things they are certain: vast new universes are being organized in outer space, and the mysterious mobilization of perfected ascenders has gone on for ages upon ages. Placing these two movements side by side, it is natural to conjecture that the finaliters will serve in the outer universes, where aggregations of matter larger than any present superuniverse are gathering.

text: But though we really know nothing about the plans of the Architects of the Master Universe respecting these outer creations, nevertheless, of three things we are certain:

1. There actually is a vast and new system of universes gradually organizing in the domains of outer space. New orders of physical creations, enormous and gigantic circles of swarming universes upon universes far out beyond the present bounds of the peopled and organized creations, are actually visible through your telescopes. At present, these outer creations are wholly physical; they are apparently uninhabited and seem to be devoid of creature administration.

2. For ages upon ages there continues the unexplained and wholly mysterious Paradise mobilization of the perfected and ascendant beings of time and space, in association with the six other finaliter corps.

It is increasingly the belief of all Uversa that the assembling Corps of the Finality are destined to some future service in the universes of outer space, where we already are able to identify the clustering of at least seventy thousand aggregations of matter, each of which is greater than any one of the present superuniverses.

ch37.s3.u3.k: We evolve in the Supreme, and he evolves in us.
ch37.s3.u3.p: The outer universes will be magnificent, yet they will lack one thing: the participation of ascending beings, through finite experience, in the evolution of the Supreme Being. We now suffer many difficulties because the sovereignty of God the Supreme is not yet complete, but for that very reason we share the unique experience of his evolution. The incompleteness of the present age is a deprivation, and at the same time a privilege that will not come again.

text: We venture the forecast of future and greater outer universes of inhabited worlds, new spheres peopled with new orders of exquisite and unique beings, a material universe sublime in its ultimacy, a vast creation lacking in only one important detail—the presence of actual finite experience in the universal life of ascendant existence. Such a universe will come into being under a tremendous experiential handicap: the deprivation of participation in the evolution of the Almighty Supreme.

During the present universe age the evolving personalities of the grand universe suffer many difficulties due to the incomplete actualization of the sovereignty of God the Supreme, but we are all sharing the unique experience of his evolution. We evolve in him and he evolves in us.

ch37.s4.u1.k: The seventh place in the corps of finality is still vacant.
ch37.s4.u1.p: Every finaliter company has a place not yet filled. There are now only six classes of permanent members, and not even the finaliters know who their seventh comrade will be. It may be a being originating in the outer universes, or a Paradise personality not yet created. This vacant place is a sign that theology does not explain everything. Even at the end of the ascent there remain an open future and a waiting.

text: As the Mortal Corps of the Finality is at present constituted, there are just six classes of permanent members. The finaliters, as might be expected, engage in much speculation as to the identity of their future comrades, but there is little agreement among them.

One of us holds the opinion that this vacant place in the corps will be filled by some type of being of origin in the new universe of their future service; the other inclines to the belief that this place will be occupied by some type of Paradise personality not yet created, eventuated, or trinitized.

ch37.s4.u2.k: Partnerships of Creator and creature will become the sympathetic rulers of future universes.
ch37.s4.u2.p: The Adjuster, the highest known manifestation of the First Source and Center, and man, the lowest form of intelligent life able to know the Father, are fused into one. The text calls this mysterious union a wonderful adventure and romance. The text foresees these children of the Supreme, so united, administering a gigantic creation. Having started from the lowest place and passed through every stage by experience, they can understand and sympathize with those they govern. A lowly origin turns out to be a qualification.

text: What an adventure! What a romance! A gigantic creation to be administered by the children of the Supreme, these personalized and humanized Adjusters, these Adjusterized and eternalized mortals, these mysterious combinations and eternal associations of the highest known manifestation of the essence of the First Source and Center and the lowest form of intelligent life capable of comprehending and attaining the Universal Father.

ch37.s4.u3.k: What a glorious destiny for the animal-origin children of time.
ch37.s4.u3.p: Born on a planet, passing through the morontia worlds, ascending the spirit universes, traversing Havona, finding God, and attaining Paradise: the text calls this a glorious destiny for the animal-origin children of time. Man's frame is dust, yet if he truly wills and desires it, the heritage of the ages is his. The theology of the Corps of the Finality is, in the end, God's invitation extended to the human will.

text: Evolutionary mortals are born on the planets of space, pass through the morontia worlds, ascend the spirit universes, traverse the Havona spheres, find God, attain Paradise, and are mustered into the primary Corps of the Finality, therein to await the next assignment of universe service. … And as we view this sublime spectacle, we all exclaim: What a glorious destiny for the animal-origin children of time, the material sons of space!

True it is, you mortals are of earthly, animal origin; your frame is indeed dust. But if you actually will, if you really desire, surely the heritage of the ages is yours, and you shall someday serve throughout the universes in your true characters—children of the Supreme God of experience and divine sons of the Paradise Father of all personalities.

ch37.qs1: How does the teaching that endless service awaits even after finding God change my idea of salvation?
ch37.qs2: What comfort and what responsibility does it give me that those who went before are still serving in this world?
ch37.qs3: If my lowly beginnings and present difficulties may one day qualify me to understand and serve others, how shall I regard today's trials?
